invariants.rule: PortfolioCore represents explicit identity-linked references and evidence metadata; it never manufactures competence, merit, trust or authorization from presentation content.

Identity, portfolio, merit, recommendation, trust and competence states derive only from explicit provenance-bearing evidence; display text, self-authored claims, ranking position or AI inference never become verified evidence by themselves.

Distinct canonical identities maintain independent evidence histories; merit, Tier, trust and recommendation histories are not mergeable across identities unless a future explicit canonical identity-merger contract exists.

[2] Define human/public portfolio views as derived projections over permitted portfolio evidence and Project links without rewriting source evidence.

references.purpose: Merit signals may be projected but remain MeritCore-owned.

semantics.authority_rule: Viewing projection grants no Project/artifact authority.
semantics.cv_rule: A living CV-like projection may combine Portfolio evidence with MeritCore signals without merging their semantic ownership.
semantics.filter_rule: Reconciled source clauses: [1] Views may filter/sort/group records but cannot create or modify evidence. [2] Visibility/privacy rules are applied before projection.
semantics.merit_rule: Portfolio projection does not calculate MeritCore points/Tier.
semantics.ordering_rule: Reconciled source clauses: [1] Presentation order is non-semantic unless explicitly declared. [2] Presentation ordering is explicit and non-authoritative.
semantics.privacy_rule: Projection obeys identity/evidence visibility and AccessCore policy.
semantics.separation_rule: Authored description, evidence verification state and MeritCore-derived values are visibly/machine-readably distinct.
semantics.source_rule: Projection reads exact portfolio items/references/artifact links.
semantics.trace_rule: Displayed machine-significant claims retain source refs.
